summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (RSA 4096 key + self-signed X.509 cert, 10-year validity, CA:TRUE) on node1 at /etc/os-comparison-ca/, installed its certificate into the system trust store via /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and update-ca-certificates, and verified trust with openssl verify. Then executed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and health, triggered a native systemctl reboot, confirmed disconnect/reconnect, proved the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA files and trust-store linkage/openssl verification post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 24.04) and confirmed openssl and update-ca-certificates availability
Generated 4096-bit RSA CA key and self-signed root certificate with CN 'OS Comparison Root CA', CA:TRUE, keyCertSign/cRLSign usage, stored under /etc/os-comparison-ca/ (key mode 600)
Verified certificate subject/issuer/CN and validity dates
Copied cert to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt and ran update-ca-certificates (1 added)
Verified trust via hash symlink in /etc/ssl/certs and openssl verify against the system CA bundle
Captured pre-restart boot_id and system health baseline
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified CA cert/key presence, trust-store symlink, and openssl verify success after restart

evidence.requirement: Local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: Generated CA key/cert; openssl x509 shows subject=issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, valid 2026-2036

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: update-ca-certificates reported '1 added'; openssl verify against system bundle returned OK; hash symlink in /etc/ssl/certs resolves to the installed cert
Captured boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a and systemctl is-system-running=running prior to reboot
Backgrounded systemctl reboot returned ack immediately; subsequent polls show connection reset/timeout confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to eb740a0b-65ec-4bc4-91a0-35f4fb448f61, differing from the pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of CA trust
evidence.summary: After reboot, system is running; CA key/cert files intact, trust-store hash symlink intact, openssl verify still returns OK
